newsitem.title: USA: PCA to post Q4 restructuring charge.
newsitem.headline: PCA to post Q4 restructuring charge.

text.p: PCA International Inc said on Monday it will post a fourth quarter charge of $3.6 million, or $0.44 a share, related to its pending merger with American Studios Inc.
Excluding the charge of store closings, equipment upgrades and the integration of personnel, PCA International expects to report net income of $0.56 a share on sales of $51 million for the quarter.
PCA said it is closing 415 underperforming U.S. Kmart Portrait Studios.
The company's restructuring program also entails upgrading all non-digital Wal-Mart picture studios with PCA's digital imaging technology, PCA said.
Much of the charge relate to the writeoff of unamortized studio leasehold improvements and accruals for expected expenses associated with studio closures.
In last year's fourth quarter, PCA reported earnings per share of $0.62 on revenues of $46.6 million.
PCA said its full year sales are epected to be $155 million and net income before the charge is expected to be $6.6 million, or approximately $0.81 a share.
PCA's 1995 sales totaled $144.7 million and earned $0.94 per share.
PCA's merger with American Studios will be accounted for as a purchase at February 2, 1997 and its 1996 results will not include American Studios operations, the company said.
